production_consumptions_source_check.name: production_consumptions_source_check
production_consumptions_source_check.value:
(
                ("production_consumptions"."source_type" = 'product_batch'
                    AND "production_consumptions"."product_batch_id" IS NOT NULL
                    AND "production_consumptions"."source_batch_id" IS NULL
                    AND "production_consumptions"."product_id" IS NOT NULL
                    AND "production_consumptions"."source_recipe_id" IS NULL)
                OR
                ("production_consumptions"."source_type" = 'production_batch'
                    AND "production_consumptions"."source_batch_id" IS NOT NULL
                    AND "production_consumptions"."product_batch_id" IS NULL
                    AND "production_consumptions"."source_recipe_id" IS NOT NULL
                    AND "production_consumptions"."product_id" IS NULL)
            )

recipe_items_ref_check.name: recipe_items_ref_check
recipe_items_ref_check.value:
(
                ("recipe_items"."ref_type" = 'product' AND "recipe_items"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recipe_items"."child_recipe_id" IS NULL)
                OR
                ("recipe_items"."ref_type" = 'recipe' AND "recipe_items"."child_recipe_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recipe_items"."product_id" IS NULL)
            )

recipes_category_required_check.name: recipes_category_required_check
recipes_category_required_check.value:
(
                ("recipes"."type" = 'filling' AND "recipes"."category" IS NULL)
                OR
                ("recipes"."type" IN ('preparation', 'dish') AND "recipes"."category" IS NOT NULL)
            )

stock_movements_transfer_id_check.name: stock_movements_transfer_id_check
stock_movements_transfer_id_check.value:
(
                ("stock_movements"."type" IN ('transfer_in', 'transfer_out') AND "stock_movements"."transfer_id" IS NOT NULL)
                OR
                ("stock_movements"."type" NOT IN ('transfer_in', 'transfer_out') AND "stock_movements"."transfer_id" IS NULL)
            )
